import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import sklearn as sk
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

prices = pd.read_csv("housing.csv")

#### Descriptive Statistics ----

#1. Overview of the dataset
print("The dimensions of the dataset are:", prices.shape)
print(prices.describe())

#2. Correlation matrix
corr_matrix = prices.corr()
print(corr_matrix["median_house_value"].sort_values(ascending=False))

#3. Manipulate dataset: keep only relevant features features with corr > 0.1
prices = prices.drop(columns=["km_of_road", "population","total_bedrooms"])
households = prices.pop("households")

#### Fit the Models ----
#1. Divide to test and train
data_train, data_test = train_test_split(prices, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
y_train = data_train.pop("median_house_value")
y_test = data_test.pop("median_house_value")

#2. Define and fit Linear Regression
lin_reg = LinearRegression()
lin_reg.fit(data_train, y_train)
y_pred_linear = lin_reg.predict(data_test)

#3. Define and fit Random Forest
rf_reg = RandomForestRegressor(random_state=42)
rf_reg.fit(data_train, y_train)
y_pred_rf = rf_reg.predict(data_test)

#### Model Comparison ----
#1. Calculate R² scores
r2_linear = r2_score(y_test, y_pred_linear)
r2_rf = r2_score(y_test, y_pred_rf)

print(f"\nModel Performance Comparison:")
print(f"Linear Regression R² Score: {r2_linear:.3f}")
print(f"Random Forest R² Score: {r2_rf:.3f}")

#### Rerun with houshold ----

households_train , households_test = train_test_split(households, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
data_train["households"] = households_train
data_test["households"] = households_test

#2. Define and fit Linear Regression
lin_reg = LinearRegression()
lin_reg.fit(data_train, y_train)
y_pred_linear = lin_reg.predict(data_test)

#3. Define and fit Random Forest
rf_reg = RandomForestRegressor(random_state=42)
rf_reg.fit(data_train, y_train)
y_pred_rf = rf_reg.predict(data_test)

#### Model Comparison ----
#1. Calculate R² scores
r2_linear = r2_score(y_test, y_pred_linear)
r2_rf = r2_score(y_test, y_pred_rf)

print(f"\nModel Performance Comparison:")
print(f"Linear Regression R² Score: {r2_linear:.3f}")
print(f"Random Forest R² Score: {r2_rf:.3f}")
